_meta.THREE_FILE_MODEL: LOCKED 2026-07-29 by Michael: 'every script needs to be known to be hand copied by me into fmp. so no changelogs in the script. less status bullshit in the header.' The split axis is TYPED-vs-NOT-TYPED, not prose-vs-code. (1) <Name>.fmscript = THE COPY TARGET. Select all, copy, dictate into Manage Scripts. Everything in it is meant to be typed: a 4-6 line contract header plus inline # comments that are real script steps. NOTHING else. (2) <Name>.notes.md = status, defects, history, design reasoning, rewrite checklists, fixture expectations. Read on a phone, never typed. (3) this file = machine-readable status + the graph. Full rules: README.md.
_meta.whyFileBoundary: The copy zone must be a WHOLE FILE, never a section above a marker. A `#` line is a valid FileMaker comment step, so over-selecting pastes silently-wrong garbage into a script instead of failing. Whole-file copy is the only version that cannot be got wrong at 2am.
_meta.rowProseRule: Row `note` / `supersededWhy` are ONE-LINERS - the warning that travels with the tree. Detail lives in notesRef and is NOT duplicated here. A long prose note in this manifest is a projection of the sidecar and it is the copy that goes stale.
_meta.model: Flat scripts[] array. The renderer builds the folder tree from each row's `folder` and the CALLS/CALLED-BY graph from `calls[]`; `calledBy` is DERIVED at render time by inverting every row's calls[] and is NEVER stored. Listing is not loading: tree + graph read only this file; a body is fetched lazily on drill-in.

bodyValues.present: The .fmscript EXISTS at scriptRef and contains real content. Safe to drill in.
bodyValues.pending: NO FILE EXISTS at scriptRef yet. Tree placeholder only. Do NOT link to it as readable.

_meta.bodyNote: `body` added 2026-07-29 AFTER A REAL FAILURE. schemaVersion 2.1 shipped 20 rows carrying scriptRef paths when exactly ONE of those files existed. The manifest asserted a tree of readable bodies over an almost-empty directory - the same defect the README had one commit earlier, which made it two instances in one PR. A POINTER IS A CLAIM. Never write one for a file you have not created.

stateValues.built: Verified present in the FileMaker file on a named date.
stateValues.superseded: DO NOT IMPLEMENT. Written against an older schema.

_meta.stateNote: `state` = the SCRIPT's standing in FileMaker. `body` = whether documentation exists here. Independent: a superseded script can have a full body worth reading, and a golden script can have no body yet.
_meta.folderTreeNote: CORRECTED 2026-07-29. schemaVersion 2.0 used imports/navigation/triggers/utilities, which matched nothing in the file. `utilities` survives as ONE flagged divergence holding commitRecord - Michael to confirm whether the live file has that folder.
_meta.bodyNature: DICTATION reference - the exact steps to TYPE into Manage Scripts. NOT paste-round-trippable, because FileMaker's script clipboard is XML. Unlike .fmcalc, which does paste back verbatim. Legibility over round-trip, deliberately - and the copy-target rule is the consequence of that trade.
_meta.sourceOfBodies: Ported from the ClickUp per-script pages, which held real contracts, step text and in two cases full FMXML. Moved, not invented and not summarized; defects found during the port are flagged in the sidecars rather than silently patched.
_meta.keying: Script names are unique per FileMaker file, so `name` is a safe graph key.
_meta.callsResolution: calls[] may target a script OR a custom function; the linter resolves against this file first, then functions/_index.json.
_meta.capDiscipline: Keep rows minimal so this index stays under the ~30KB read cap. Moving prose to the sidecars is what bought the headroom back. If it crosses, shard by top-level folder behind a pointer - still no renderer change.
_meta.buildOrderNote: ORDER IS A CORRECTNESS MATTER. FMP19 has no native transactions, so atomicity needs every write to flow through ONE relationship from ONE parent record. That parent is the ReceivedFunds receipt. Build the txn_* wrapper before the receipt table exists and the only parent available is Loans - so one check across two loans has TWO parents and Revert Record rolls back half, shipping a silent partial rollback. Table before wrapper.
_meta.coverage: 7 bodies present of 20 scripts (8 files counting the pre-existing commitRecord). 5 notes sidecars cover those 7 (the txn_* trio shares txn_TRIO.notes.md — one design, three entry points). The 13 pending bodies have real content on their old ClickUp pages; porting is mechanical, not a design task.
